title: The Many Classist, Racist, Fascistic Shades of Stephen Miller – In His Own Words
author: Team Zeteo
content:
From his days in high school running for student government to his role as the
mastermind of [Trump's](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-us-past-christian-maga-ryan)
federal crackdown on minorities, White House Senior Advisor [Stephen
Miller](https://zeteo.com/p/who-is-stephen-miller-trump-immigration-
fascism?utm_source=publication-search) has always shown a xenophobic streak.

He defended torture as showing **" respect towards other cultures,"** mimicked
[Nazi](https://zeteo.com/p/first-draft-teenage-mutant-nazi-
turtles?utm_source=publication-search) chief propagandist Joseph Goebbels at
[Charlie Kirk's](https://zeteo.com/p/charlie-kirk-in-his-own-
words?utm_source=publication-search) [memorial](https://zeteo.com/p/charlie-
kirks-memorial-showed-how?utm_source=publication-search), and even labeled the
Democratic Party a "domestic [extremist](https://zeteo.com/p/settler-walks-
free-as-israel-holds?utm_source=publication-search) organization."

In this 'lowlight' reel, **Zeteo** traces some of his most hateful, strange,
and downright cringey moments along the way.
